name: Ostkustleden Etapp 2, Nynäs - Lönhult
description: Nynäs to Lönhult. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Naturkartan page says 20.6 km, official GPX computes 20.622734 km, the official PDF map title says 21 km, Döderhult says cirka 22 km, and OSM/route-app lineage is around 21.5-21.6 km.
The official GPX start exactly matches the reviewed Etapp 1 digital endpoint, but Nynässtugan is about 565.9 m direct away and is reached by the GPX around route km 0.699.
Older/maintainer wording says the well can dry in late summer; current Naturkartan wording says the well has dried and Hummeln water must always be boiled.

One agent report said Lönhult has no electricity and that water must be boiled, but main-thread checks of Naturkartan and Döderhult pages found electric power/electric hotplate and summer water at the cabin corner, with no current official boil-water wording located for Lönhult.
Official Naturkartan pages use Bråhultsjöns badplats / Bråhultesjön in text, while OSM may call parts of the same cluster Saxtorps badplats.
Naturkartan Nynäs page still carries a late-summer/autumn 2025 forestry/RestoRED notice, while the rules lane found no current Länsstyrelsen Humlenäs news.

facilities.name: Nynäs / Övernattningsstuga Nynäs
facilities.description: Ostkustleden overnight cabin shared with Etapp 1. Simple standard, no electricity, dry toilet on the yard, unreliable water; the official GPX reaches the cabin area around route km 0.70 even though the GPX stage start is farther east.

facilities.name: Nynäs dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry/simple toilet at the Nynäs cabin yard.

facilities.name: Bråhultsjöns badplats
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place by Bråhultsjön/Bråhultesjön adjacent to Ostkustleden, with grass beach, jetties, changing huts, dry toilet, pergola/tables, and grill place.

facilities.name: Bråhultsjöns badplats rest area
facilities.description: Rest area with pergola, tables, benches, bathing-place amenities, and lake view.

facilities.name: Bråhultsjöns badplats grillplats
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace at the Bråhultsjön bathing-place cluster. Subject to current fire bans.

facilities.name: Bråhultsjöns badplats dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the Bråhultsjön bathing-place cluster.

facilities.name: Lönhults kvarn
facilities.description: Historic mill site and waterfall explicitly passed by Etapp 2, with remains from the mill period and bathing possibility below the fall according to Döderhult.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Lönhult
facilities.description: Ostkustleden-only endpoint cabin near the Kristdala-Hultsfred road and Lake Näjern/Nejern. Kitchen has wood stove and electric hotplate, simple kitchen equipment, wood shed, summer water at the cabin corner, and dry toilet behind the barn. Outdoor fires are not allowed.

facilities.name: Lönhult dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet behind the barn near Lönhult cabin.

facilities.name: Grytbäcken bus stop
facilities.description: Best public-transport access for the Nynäs/Humlenäs side of Etapp 2.

facilities.name: Parkering Lönhult
facilities.description: Free parking on both sides of the road by Lönhult cabin.

facilities.name: Bråbo B&B och Café
facilities.description: Nearby seasonal food/lodging in Bråbygden, about 1.6 km off the route near the Bråhultsjön area.
